main.description:
Recovery-admin designation record for a stewarded arbiter. This record
is the source of truth for who may recover the arbiter: the arbiter
server re-reads it on every `town.muni.arbiter.installPolicy` call, and
rewriting it rotates the recovery admin with effect on the next call.
Written by the arbiter server at provisioning/import time (did = the
provisioning caller) and re-written by it when repairing a
half-provisioned account.

did.description:
The DID of the account's designated recovery admin — the only
account that may install policies via `town.muni.arbiter.installPolicy`
(until the record is rewritten).
